quest.title: On the Stage, Behind the Stage
quest.description: Something seems to be troubling Tea Master Liu Su of Heyu Tea House...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Pear Orchard Stage: Yun-Han Style x1

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Ugh, just my luck. I'm not gonna tell any more stories today, not today, I swear it!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's going on?

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: This tiny little stage is really annoying me. It's been poorly maintained for decades! It squeaks at the lightest touch!

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: I've long told our boss, Fan Er'ye, that it needed to be replaced, but he would always brush me off, saying that he couldn't find a good carpenter to do the job.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Today, when I was telling the story of "The Wrath of Haishan," it would make that infernal squeak with every pose I would strike.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Nothing could've killed the mood more effectively. Everyone present burst out laughing, and some even made fun of me for it.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: I'm fed up with it. I must bring a good carpenter to see Fan Er'ye. Then we'll see what other excuses he can come up with this time!

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: You're from the Adventurers' Guild, right? Can I just directly ask you to find a carpenter for me?

choices.text: How do I find the carpenter?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Oh, my bad. You don't look like you're from around here. How can I expect you to know where to find good carpenters?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Well, then, how about you go to Qingce Village and look for Master Lu at Fanmu Carpenter's. He's known for good skills. Please ask him if he's willing to help me.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: He can send an apprentice if he's not available.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Any carpenter from Fanmu Carpenter's can manage the job, and if they build it right, that means we can finally have a befitting stage for Ms. Yun.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Hah! I'm such a genius! With this reasoning that I just came up with, I don't see how Er'ye could say no again this time.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Just rest assured, as long as you bring the carpenter here, you'll be paid in full.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Then I'll be counting on you. I'm at the tea house every day. Come to me when you've found our carpenter.

talks.objective: Head to Qingce Village and look for Master Lu

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Er'ye, you need to seriously think about it, or else they'll all go to Third-Round Knockout.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: #What's the hurry, young {M#man}{F#lady}? Would you like to sit down and have a cup of tea?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You explain Liu Su's request to Master Lu...

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Oh, it's not difficult to build a new stage, but I'm afraid I can't help.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Liyue Harbor is too far away. No one will be taking care of Fanmu Carpenter's if I go.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: What's more, I'm too old to travel this far. It would take a toll on my fragile bones.

choices.text: Then we won't bother Fanmu Carpenter's.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Hang on a second. Since you've traveled all the way here, why don't I recommend someone capable to you?

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Although he's not yet my apprentice, I've been considering the possibility of accepting him...

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Master Lu, I'm almost done with the four-chair set the village head wanted, but I ran out of wood for the last chair.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Dayu, thank you for helping out in the village.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Speak of the devil! I was about to say that Dayu can handle your request as well.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Do you have a job for me? But I'm not yet Master Lu's apprentice, so I can't represent Fanmu Carpenter's.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Calm down there. They came from Liyue Harbor and want us to build a new stage for Heyu Tea House.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Oh, you want "us" to build a stage? "Us" means me and Master Lu. Did you hear that, Granny Ruoxin?

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Yes I did. Hehe, Master Lu, Dayu really wants to be your apprentice — he only follows you around at Fanmu Carpenter's when there are so many other choices.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: He's a diligent and kind boy. It's time you gave the nod.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Got it, got it. I've already asked him to take jobs on my behalf. I think I've made myself quite clear.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Thank you, Master!

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Dayu, the first job I'm going to officially send you on is to build a stage for Heyu Tea House. Do your best and make me proud.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Piece of cake — I've worked for the carpenter who built the stage for the Jade Chamber.

response.speaker: Master Lu
response.text: Don't be so proud yet. The stage of Heyu Tea House has lasted for decades. You gotta build a sturdy one for them too.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Oh, so this is all for Er'ye's tea house? How has he managed to never replace his tiny stage for so long...

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: I'll take the job. Lemme finish the last chair in the set, and I'll come with you.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: I'm sorry that you'll have to wait a bit.

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: I need three pieces of Pine Wood for the last chair. I'm going to collect some.

choices.text: We'll have to wait a bit?

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Well, if you don't want to wait, then you'll have to magically produce three pieces of Pine Wood right here, right now.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Got it...

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: So you really can do that! Then could I trouble you to bring me one Red Dye?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Now, wait a minute!

response.speaker: Dayu
response.text: Haha, don't get so worked up. A great person like you must have a greater heart.

choices.text: Guess I can kiss that commission fee goodbye, then.

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: Honestly, I'm quite shocked that Er'ye never replaced the stage for all the years...

dialogues.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
dialogues.text: He was stingy as a young man, and he's certainly got even worse over the years.

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Hmph, I know him well enough to tell that he's making things difficult for himself again, even at this age...

response.speaker: Granny Ruoxin
response.text: Forget it. The little girl from the Yun family is going to visit me. I gotta go home and make some preparations for my guest.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Here they are.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Dayu busies himself making the chair.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: The last chair is finished. Here you are, Granny Ruoxin. Now, time to head to the tea house.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Take care, Master. I'll be back in a few days.

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: Alright, be safe.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Well then, if I leave now, I'll reach Liyue Harbor by tomorrow evening.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: See you at the Heyu Tea House then.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: What do you mean? Don't tell me that you're still arguing amongst yourselves?

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Oh, I get it. Mr. Liu Su wants to build a new stage, but he doesn't get to make the call here. Fan Er'ye, who is actually in charge, isn't keen on building something new. Fine.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Just let me know when you two have things sorted out. I've just had a tiring trip and would like to get some rest while waiting.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: *sigh* This is just great...

choices.text: So, our trip is a waste in the end?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Be patient. Let me try talking to him again.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Er'ye, if you don't want to spend a small sum of money on this stage, you'll lose a big fortune in the future.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Just think about it: Every time Ms. Yun gives her marvelous "spear flourish" performance, the audience will hear the squeak of the stage before they even get to applaud.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Isn't that simply embarrassing? The Yun-Han Opera Troupe isn't obliged to perform at our tea house. They could go somewhere else if they're displeased. That would be a huge loss on our side.

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: Ms. Yun is a dear friend, she would never do that to me.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: You're quite an optimist, aren't you? But I heard that many people have chosen to go to Third-Round Knockout instead of our tea house lately.

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: Iron Tongue Tian has gotten even more popular than me. Could you try to be a little more realistic?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: With all the money Ms. Yun has earned for the tea house, don't tell me that you can't even afford to build a new stage.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Did someone just call my name? Oh, it's you, Mr. Liu Su. You look angry. What happened?

response.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
response.text: It's nothing. I'm not angry, actually. Well, are you here to perform today?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'm just here to have some tea and pay you and Er'ye a visit.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: #Ah, if it isn't {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'd say it's fate. I am not at all surprised.

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: Haha, Ms. Yun certainly knows the art of conversation! Come, friends, I have some newly made tea from Qiaoying Village. Let's brew a pot.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Er'ye, when I was downstairs, I heard that you are going to rebuild the stage. So, this day has finally come?

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: Ahem... This will need a bit more consideration...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Oh? A bit more consideration...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Speaking of which, do you know who I visited in the Qingce Village today?

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: You can just directly tell me that you went to see Ruoxin again.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Good guess! Granny Ruoxin was asking about Heyu Tea House, and I told her that everything was the same as when she was young. Then she said...

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: What did she say?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Oops... I forgot what she said!

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: You seem to have a good memory, but why does it have to fail on this particular day with something so important!

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: Forget it. She'll be happy with things remaining as they were.

response.speaker: Fan Er'ye
response.text: Young people are always after new things and have little respect for the past. All you know is forcing me to rebuild the stage. The more I explain, the more you'll find me annoying, hmph.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: #Please don't get mad, Er'ye. Let's have tea, and I shall brew some. {NICKNAME} and Mr. Liu Su, could I trouble you to bring me some tea?

choices.text: I was just thinking about you...

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Hehe, you're being humorous.

choices.text: But what about our commission fee?

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun, I was wondering why Er'ye refused to build a new stage despite all its benefits.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Now I see why — thanks to your clever choice of topic.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: I understand his nostalgia. Yes I really do, but I didn't expect him to have held on to that for decades.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Now we know the reason behind it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't get it.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: This is an old story, but since you're involved, I guess it won't hurt to tell you.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Fan Er'ye used to be an opera singer when he was young, and he often performed together with Granny Ruoxin. They would usually play a couple. Perhaps Er'ye wanted it to be real.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: But Granny Ruoxin had feelings for someone else. Later, she grew tired of stage performance and then decided to go to Qingce Village with the one she loved.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: But that person didn't make it to Qingce Village with Granny Ruoxin, leaving her to live alone in the village ever since.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Knowing that I often visit her, Er'ye would ask me about her from time to time.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: I can tell that he still cares for Granny Ruoxin. He sees the stage as a symbol of their past and thus doesn't want to tear it down.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: *sigh* Since the stage means so much to Er'ye, he's not gonna let us build a new one. Guess all our efforts are wasted...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: That's not necessarily the case. I have a way to change his mind. Give me some time, Mr. Liu Su.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Really? As long as the stage gets repaired, I'll be in your debt, Ms. Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: #I won't ask for too much. Please tell "Ring of Raining Blades" to its very end. {NICKNAME}, you can join me if you want.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Somehow Yun Jin feels very different than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Our tea house has collaborated with the Yun-Han Opera Troupe for decades. Ms. Yun would naturally feel more approachable around us.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: No problem. I'll make some time and tell the story just for you.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Alright, now that we've finished the tea, it's time to talk to Er'ye.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Er'ye, when we were drinking tea, I suddenly remembered what Granny Ruoxin told me.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Oh, what did she say?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: She said: "Er'ye always loves to make things difficult for himself. I feel sad about it."

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: *sigh* She truly understands me.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: But it seems that she doesn't miss the old stage. I'm the only person who can't let go.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: What a fool was I to be so obsessed with this stage. Alright, you can rebuild it as you want.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's a touching thing to have kept that stage for so many years. I don't find it foolish at all. Please don't think of it that way.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: The stage must be rebuilt, but we mustn't damage what Er'ye wants to preserve in memory.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: So you've finally made your decision? Great, I'll start working right away.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Here, take a look at my blueprint. The grand stage on the Jade Chamber was built based on it.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: According to this design, we need to tear down the walls on the two sides, and...

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: Let's not get ahead of ourselves. I think we need to repair the stage instead of building something entirely new. Since the problem is caused by the squeaky wood floor, why don't we repair the floor first?

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: As for the rest, we can talk about it later. What do you think, Mr. Liu Su?

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: So long as the stage won't affect performance, I have no objections to Ms. Yun and Er'ye's arrangements.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Huh, is that all you want? So you don't need me to build a new stage?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: I agree. Ms. Yun's idea is a good one.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: As it happens, we don't need to buy the planks. We can find some at the docks.

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: #Um... May I trouble you to bring me the planks, {NICKNAME}? I'll pay you for everything in full later.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That works for me.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: ...Alright then, leave everything to me.

talks.objective: Go to the warehouse at the dock and obtain the wooden planks

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: These planks would do. I'll start right away.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Thank you for your help. Have you found three pieces of Pine Wood and one Red Dye?

dialogues.speaker: Master Lu
dialogues.text: #{M#Young man}{F#Young lady}, I took on an apprentice today! Let me make some pork stew tonight to celebrate!

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Stop nagging me about repairing the stage. Let me think about it.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: I thought it was a serious job and even brought with me the blueprint for the grand stage on the Jade Chamber. Who would've thought that the requesters hadn't even reached a consensus? Was it just a practical joke or something?

dialogues.speaker: Fan Er'ye
dialogues.text: Ms. Yun really understands me.

dialogues.speaker: Tea Master Liu Su
dialogues.text: Just one round of "Ring of Raining Blades"? No problem.

dialogues.speaker: Yun Jin
dialogues.text: It's settled then. Wonderful.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I did just come back from Qingce Village, and yes, I visited Granny Ruoxin. I directly quoted what she said. It's just...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: It's just?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Shh! It's just that I didn't quote the full sentence. What she said was:

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: "Er'ye always loves to make things difficult for himself. He's stingy with Mora, and people around him suffer for it as well. It's honestly rather saddening."

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Although what she said was true, Er'ye would've been irritated had I repeated exactly every word, so I took the liberty of omitting the other half.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Great, this is my second favorite thing: to spend some time in the tea house.

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: Even when Mr. Liu Su isn't telling a story, the mere sound of the bustling city itself is soothing.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Then, what's your most favorite thing?

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: It's definitely singing the opera on the stage!

response.speaker: Yun Jin
response.text: I'd love to chat with you more, but I believe that Mr. Liu Su is still waiting for you to bring him his planks so that the stage can get fixed.

dialogues.speaker: Dayu
dialogues.text: Master is right, it's difficult to work for people in cities.
